scope: Headless Flutter engine with real dart:ui and PDFium. Baseline reproduces the source/raster/PNG/decode pipeline; optimized controller cases execute the actual production PrintPreviewController. This is not a full application window or physical printer measurement.

method.runs: 39 fresh Flutter processes: 3 repeats for each of 10 pipeline/controller configurations, plus 9 one-off lifecycle diagnostics. Paired variant order alternates across repetitions. All runs completed with exit 0.
method.sourceRead: Each run begins with a fresh document; bytes includes File.readAsBytes and retains it. OS filesystem caches were not flushed, so this is not cold-disk latency. Already-cached bytes on later screen generations are not represented by these initial-open timings.
method.baselinePublication: Exact dev baseline calls onPage for every PNG and immediately publishes the list. firstPreviewAvailableUs is the first PNG ready for this callback, not completion of the eager loop. Up to two visible PNG decodes run asynchronously while later pages render; the images stay live until after measurement.
method.controllerPublication: Listener observes the first cached ui.Image notification. load completion includes the initial visible sheet and neighbor and awaited document disposal. In paired N-up=1 cases exactly two images remain cached.
method.initialDemand: Default visibleDecodeLimit=2 matches the initial controller image count for N-up=1. The baseline still rasterizes and encodes 3 small or up to 60 large-document pages. No claim is made that all eager PNGs are decoded.
method.timeBoundary: Both pipelines initialize pdfrx and connect/reset the VM profiler before timing. Controller construction/reset and PNG list/cache construction are after profiler reset and memory baseline. firstImageReadyUs is decoded image readiness, not first rendered frame. totalUs includes document close and pending visible PNG decodes, plus explicitly requested controller scroll batches.
method.memory: Linux ProcessInfo RSS and /proc/self/smaps_rollup Private_Clean+Private_Dirty, sampled every 10ms and at phase/listener boundaries. These include Flutter, Dart, PDFium and the harness. Process lifetime peak RSS includes startup and is distinct from sampled scenario peak. Native-only allocator peak and Windows private commit are not measured. Peak increments are computed per process before aggregation.
method.cacheAccounting: Lower-level peakCachePixelBytes uses 4 bytes/pixel; production sampledPeakCacheBudgetBytes uses 8 retained plus 4 active-render bytes/pixel estimates. These are different accounting models and are not compared as physical memory. The 32MiB cache budget is not a process/PDFium memory cap.
method.allocations: VM getAllocationProfile(reset:true,gc:true) before work, then current-isolate accumulators after work. Includes the probe and VM-service client overhead, excludes worker, PDFium and GPU allocations. Old screen ValueNotifier list copies, widget builds and ImageCache behavior are not modeled. No general reduction in whole-screen allocations is established.
method.cancellation: One-off diagnostics, not paired controller speedup. PNG/direct after-render cancel immediately after the native bitmap; PNG still encodes the stale result while direct discards it. Controller after-render means after first cached-image publication. During-render is 1ms after render request for PNG/direct but 1ms after load request for controller. Controller cancellation calls reset(), so it measures generation reset and native drain, not terminal route stop or closing animation.
method.reopen: Controller scroll diagnostics use sheets 0,40,0 and await each serialized task, including progressive metadata reload, raster and document close. The bytes source diagnostic retains a 47MB PDF and reopens in the same process.
method.quality: Native-only file/bytes pixel parity is recorded separately. Flutter comparison first-image dimensions match within each paired N-up=1 case. Focused unmodified source/composer tests verify mixed sizes, source reopen, text/searchable vector output and N-up layout. These do not certify physical printer output or interactive zoom appearance.
method.excludedExploration: Earlier smoke, invalid deferred-publication and visibleDecodeLimit=3 exploratory runs remain in scratch audit logs only and are excluded from this result.

environment.execution: flutter_tester, JIT with checked mode, software and deterministic Skia rendering; no UI surface
environment.contention: Shared host initially near its 8GiB limit; pressure changed during the runs. Retain all outliers and ranges. These manual debug/headless measurements are not release UI or Windows performance guarantees.

reproduction.variables: Each run records configuration keys; prefix with OTZARIA_PREVIEW_. PDF is an absolute fixture path. Default VISIBLE=2, LIMIT=60, SCALE=1.5, BUDGET_MIB=32. See PDF_OPEN_PROBE.md.
reproduction.observedRunner: Flutter wrapper was unreliable under host pressure. A minimal package with exact dependencies and symlinks to production source compiled the same runPdfPrintPreviewProbe body directly against flutter_patched_sdk/platform_strong.dill, then ran flutter_tester. The main initialized WidgetsFlutterBinding and set Pdfrx.pdfiumModulePath to the recorded native library. Test registration was bypassed; measurement code was unchanged.

focusedValidation.runner: test_core Engine and unmodified tests in flutter_tester
focusedValidation.note: These 25 exact tests were independently run by the dependency audit agent. They use test_core Engine rather than the Flutter CLI wrapper. Source/composer cases use native PDFium; controller scheduling/ownership cases use deterministic fake documents with real ui.Image.
